newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Protesters stage brief demo in Albania capital.
newsitem.headline: Protesters stage brief demo in Albania capital.

text.p: About 150 anti-government protesters staged a brief demonstration in central Tirana's Skanderbeg Square on Tuesday before scattering to evade riot police.

Eyewitnesses said the protesters converged on the square in small groups and shouted "Vlore! Vlore!" -- the name of the Adriatic port where three demonstrators have died in two days of battles with riot police. Police immediately moved against the protesters and pursued them down a side street.

The opposition Forum for Democracy has asked Tirana residents to shut down the capital's shops and schools every day for two hours after rallies scheduled for the past two weekends were broken up by riot police.

The opposition demands the resignation of President Sali Berisha's government and blames him for the collapse of pyramid investment schemes with the life savings of hundreds of thousands of Albanians.
Authorities have denied permission for a rally called by the Forum for Wednesday in a Tirana stadium.
